name.en: International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship at SHNU — March2027 one-semester study
name.zh: 上海师范大学国际中文教师奖学金（2027年3月一学期研修）

summary.en: Offered semester directions are International Chinese Language Education and Chinese Language and Literature. The award funds tuition and the standard scholarship accommodation, a living allowance of CNY2500 per month, and comprehensive medical insurance at CNY400 per person for one semester. Standard accommodation is a free university dormitory, generally a twin room; off-campus support requires prior application and host approval and is CNY700/month for this category, paid monthly or quarterly. It is a capped alternative allowance, not an unlimited rent reimbursement. Registration, absence and withdrawal rules govern actual payments; no guaranteed five-month lump sum is promised. Travel, visas and other unspecified charges are not represented as covered benefits. Apply through the official CLEC scholarship entry page and its “我要申请” (Apply) action; select the recommending institution and this host university. The official student deadline for March2027 entry is 31 October2026, Beijing time. The separate 10 November institutional review deadline is not extra time for students.
summary.zh: 一学期招生方向为国际中文教育及汉语言文学。 资助学费、奖学金规定的住宿、每月人民币2500元生活费及每人每学期400元综合医疗保险。标准住宿为学校免费宿舍，一般为双人间；校外住宿须事先申请并经接收学校批准，该类别按每月700元、按月或季度发放，是定额替代补助，不是无限额报销房租。实际生活费受报到、离境及退学等规则约束，不承诺一次性五个月总额。未将交通、签证及其他未明列费用写成已覆盖权益。 通过语合中心国际中文教师奖学金官方入口页及“我要申请”入口办理，选择推荐机构和本校为接收学校。2027年3月入学的学生申请截止日为北京时间2026年10月31日；11月10日是机构审核截止，并非学生延期。

eligibility.en: For prospective international applicants entering the named university in March 2027 for the five-month, one-semester non-degree scholarship route. This is an admission award, not an enrolled-students-only prize. Selection is competitive and admission or eligibility does not guarantee a scholarship.
eligibility.zh: 面向申请相应高校2027年3月入学、资助五个月的一学期非学历研修奖学金申请者，属于来华入学资助，并非仅限在读生的评优奖励。奖学金择优评审，符合申请条件或获得录取不保证获奖。

eligibility.en: Non-Chinese citizen; friendly to China, without a criminal record; comply with Chinese laws and host-university rules; good physical/mental health and academic/behavioral standing; interested in Chinese language education, teaching or related work.
eligibility.zh: 须为非中国籍人士，对华友好、无违法犯罪记录，遵守中国法律及接收学校规定；身心健康、品学兼优，有志于从事中文教育、教学或相关工作。

eligibility.en: Age 16–35 measured on 1 September 2026; in-service Chinese teachers may be eligible up to age 45. The age reference date is the date in the official 2026 guide, not an inferred 2027 date.
eligibility.zh: 年龄16–35周岁，以官方规定的2026年9月1日计算；在职中文教师可放宽至45周岁，不将年龄计算日自行顺延为2027年。

eligibility.en: For the directions listed for this one-semester route, HSK Level3 at least 180 and an HSKK score report are required. Test reports must be within their two-year validity. No additional minimum HSKK score is stated for this semester route.
eligibility.zh: 本条一学期项目所列方向须HSK三级至少180分，并提供HSKK成绩；成绩报告须在两年有效期内。该一学期类别未另列HSKK最低分，不套用学历类别的口试门槛。

eligibility.en: In principle, applicants who received the same type of one-semester/one-academic-year scholarship within the previous three years are not admitted again. A recommending institution is required; in-service teachers provide employment proof and an employer recommendation for the stated priority treatment. Chinese Bridge scholarship-certificate holders use their certificate under the official procedure.
eligibility.zh: 原则上不录取近三年内享受过同类一学期或一学年奖学金的申请者。须有推荐机构；在职中文教师提交任职证明及单位推荐信以适用规定的同等条件优先。汉语桥奖学金证书获得者按官方流程凭证书申请。

eligibility.en: Submit passport photo-page scan, valid HSK/HSKK reports and the recommending institution head’s recommendation. Applicants under18 also provide entrusted guardianship documentation in China, with the university’s own additional requirements. Degree-only master’s/doctoral materials are not silently applied to this non-degree route.
eligibility.zh: 提交护照照片页扫描件、有效HSK和HSKK成绩及推荐机构负责人推荐信；未满18周岁另按学校规定提交在华监护委托材料。此为非学历项目，不擅自套用硕士或博士专属材料。

eligibility.en: Register on the date stated in the admission notice; unauthorized late/non-registration, failed pre-enrollment medical examination, withdrawal or suspension can cancel the award. Living allowance is full for registration by the 15th inclusive, half for later registration; personal absence from China over15 days outside holidays suspends the absence-period allowance; suspension, withdrawal or discipline stops payment from the relevant date. The final allowance runs to half a month after the university’s completion date.
eligibility.zh: 须按录取通知书报到；未获批准不按时报到、入学体检不合格、中途退学或休学等会取消奖学金。15日及以前报到当月发全额生活费，之后报到发半月；学习期间非寒暑假因私离华超过15天停发离华期间生活费，休学、退学或纪律处分自相应日期停发。结业生活费发至学校确定的结业日期后半个月。

eligibility.en: Offered semester directions are International Chinese Language Education and Chinese Language and Literature.
eligibility.zh: 一学期招生方向为国际中文教育及汉语言文学。

eligibility.en: For an applicant under18, parents must formally appoint a resident foreign national or Chinese citizen in China as guardian and submit notarized guardianship-guarantee documents. SHNU offers scholarship twin rooms; off-campus accommodation requires advance approval from its International Student Development Center. A separate application fee for this one-semester route is not published in the notice.
eligibility.zh: 未满18周岁者须由父母正式委托在华常住外国人或中国人担任监护人，提交监护人保证书公证材料。上师大提供奖学金生双人间，校外住宿须提前向国际学生发展中心申请批准。通知未单独公布本条一学期项目的申请费。

eligibility.en: BLCU requires all applicants to provide their highest-education diploma or expected-graduation proof; final diploma must be supplied before starting/registration. For applicants under18, parents must entrust guardianship to a non-Chinese citizen residing in China or a Chinese citizen residing in Beijing and provide a notarized guarantee. False documents or concealed passport visa records cancel eligibility; BLCU may require supplements. Only one Chinese-government scholarship may be applied for; duplicate applications invalidate eligibility. A semester-specific application fee and specific scholarship campus allocation are not stated in this notice.
eligibility.zh: 北语要求所有申请者提交最高学历证明或预毕业证明，并在开学报到前补交正式学历证明。未满18周岁者由父母委托在华居住的非中国籍人士或在北京居住的中国公民监护，并提供公证保证书；虚假材料或隐瞒护照签证记录会取消资格，学校可要求补件。每人只能申请一种中国政府机构奖学金，重复申请无效并取消资格。本通知未列本条一学期项目的申请费及具体奖学金校区分配。
